title: Bar Drop Fresh Mint 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Fresh Mint by Drop is a clean and botanical palate cleanser. It offers the authentic taste of garden mint, providing a green, leafy sweetness that is refreshingly simple. A subtle cooling menthol undertone enhances the herbal notes, creating a breezy and crisp vaping experience perfect for all-day use. This e-liquid features a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, which ensures the crispness of the mint leaf flavour is preserved without being muted by excess thickener. Ideally suited for low-wattage MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) kits, the nicotine salt blend delivers a smooth, satisfying hit in 5mg, 10mg, or 20mg strengths. Manufactured by UK brand Drop, Bar Drop Salts range of nic salt e-liquids focus on fruity flavours that are endlessly popular as well as a few unique profiles you won’t find anywhere else.
